Klamath Lake, Oregon: An Open-Water Fishing Day

Make Klamath Lake the setting for an Oregon fishing trip. Spend time on the water and follow the bite as conditions change.

About this water

The fishery source record for Klamath Lake, United States, identifies Rainbow trout and Yellow perch.

For Klamath Lake, compare a trout plan with a perch plan before choosing a lake-wide method. Ask which part of the water the provider proposes and how current conditions affect access. Keep the launch or shore point attached to the target choice. The research supports named fish, but it does not supply a current water-quality assessment or prove that every part of the lake offers the same opportunity.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Oregon

Anglers aged 12 or older need a fishing licence. In 2026, most ocean finfish trips also need the new Ocean Endorsement.

  • 1 day$29 USD
  • 3 days$68 USD
  • Calendar year$138 USD
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Rules for this water

  • The Upper Klamath Lake rainbow trout limit is one per day, at least 15 inches.
  • All angling in Hagelstein Park is prohibited.
